title: Daxor Expands Midwest Footprint with Launch of ezBVA Lab Program at Premier Kansas Academic Medical Center
summary: Turnkey ezBVA Lab Model Removes Capital Barriers and Leverages Established Reimbursement to Drive Rapid Clinical Adoption.
body_markdown:
Turnkey ezBVA Lab Model Removes Capital Barriers and Leverages Established Reimbursement to Drive Rapid Clinical Adoption.


**Oak Ridge, TN – November 17, 2026 —**[Daxor Corporation](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/r01/___https://www.daxor.com/investors/___.YXAzOmRheG9yOmM6ZzpmYjYwYjZhNjUxMTMwMjc2OWYyMDllZmFlZTEwY2RmYTo3OmRjODE6YzljODhmNDU3YzgxZDM0ZjRjMzc3YTY5ZDkwZmI3NWVhYjE2ZTI1N2E3MjBjMGNjNjNmM2RkMTQ4Y2IyMTNmNDpwOlQ6Tg) (Nasdaq: DXR), the global leader in blood volume measurement technology, today announced the commercial launch of a new Blood Volume Analysis (BVA®) program at a leading academic medical center in Kansas, expanding the company’s Midwest footprint and accelerating adoption of its centralized diagnostic service.


Through Daxor’s Tennessee-based ezBVA Lab, the health system gains 24-hour turnaround on direct blood volume diagnostics with zero upfront capital expenditure or onsite laboratory buildout. This turnkey, lab-as-a-service workflow simplifies institutional onboarding and supports scalable test volume growth across clinical care teams.


“Launching our BVA program at a major academic medical center in Kansas demonstrates continued commercial momentum in the Midwest and underscores the scalability of our ezBVA Lab model,” said Annette Plishka, Senior Vice President of Commercialization at Daxor. “By removing upfront capital barriers and leveraging established reimbursement, we enable hospitals to adopt precision volume measurement rapidly, driving recurring test utilization while reducing readmissions and total cost of care.”


**About Daxor Corporation**


[Daxor Corporation](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/r01/___https://daxor.com/___.YXAzOmRheG9yOmM6ZzpmYjYwYjZhNjUxMTMwMjc2OWYyMDllZmFlZTEwY2RmYTo3OmUwOTk6ZDc1YzdmZmIxODE3YWJlMGMxYTUwNmM1OTgzMGY2N2ExZmY1MzAyMDZlYmM0NzkyMmU2MjNiYzJhZGFmZjNhMjpwOlQ6Tg) (Nasdaq: DXR) is tackling healthcare’s “multi-billion-dollar silent crisis”, the inability to precisely measure blood volume. This often results in suboptimal care, prolonged hospital stays, and increased readmissions for many high-cost medical conditions like heart failure and those requiring ICU care. With 50 years of experience and innovation, Daxor is proud to manufacture and distribute its patented, FDA-cleared Blood Volume Analysis (BVA) diagnostic which offers unmatched, real-time, precise data via its rapid, hand-held, lab-based system. This empowers clinicians to make individualized treatment decisions that significantly improve patient outcomes and deliver substantial efficiencies in value-based healthcare. Daxor is ISO certified and operates a U.S.-based, 20,000-square-foot state-of-the-art manufacturing facility, positioning the company for accelerated market expansion.
